description: This file is a shell script that performs tests related to git-svn globbing refspecs. It sets up a test environment, creates SVN repositories, and verifies that the globbing of branches, tags, and fetch specifications functions as expected with git-svn integration.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a description and a command block.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command and expects it to fail, for testing error conditions.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a file.
